message: Thanks. Based on your household income, most of these programs are unlikely to apply. One thing could still matter: the Child Tax Credit. How many children under 18 live with you?

summary: Illinois household of two adults (married), no children, combined earned income about $200,000 to $300,000 a year. Every programme on the list has an income limit well below this level: SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP, free or reduced-price school meals (no children in the household in any case), EITC, the refundable Child Tax Credit (requires a qualifying child), and the ACA premium tax credit (cut off at 400% of the federal poverty level, roughly $64,000 for a two-person household). No programmes recommended, and no caseworker referral is needed.
